summary: Iteration 7 testing: Google OAuth fallback session endpoint, Tenants CRUD, Rent receipt PDF, Builder Payment Plan calculator, Feedback widget + admin moderation, Admin extend_trial, and regression (login, properties, portfolio, compare). Backend: 24/24 pytest pass. Frontend: Builder Plan tab + Feedback widget + Landing demo videos verified. Tenants add-tenant form works; tenant-receipts drawer did not open in UI within 5s (minor UI issue — backend receipts endpoints all pass).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid^=tenant-receipts-] did not render [data-testid=receipts-drawer] within 5s after a newly created tenant. Possibly because newly saved tenant did not get added to list (card count was 1 before and 1 after save — save may have silently failed or list refresh didn't fire). Backend CRUD verified working via pytest — UI refresh/button wiring needs a look.
All 4 demo-video-* cards link to YouTube id 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' (Rick Roll placeholder). Replace with real product walkthroughs before launch.

Tour modal (data-testid=tour-modal) blocks clicks on add-tenant-button, builder-run-button etc. when it's shown. Automated tests must Skip tour first; consider adding 'don't show again' toggle auto-remembered by localStorage so returning users aren't blocked.

action_items: Investigate why tenant-save-button does not refresh the tenants list immediately after successful POST /api/tenants (or why receipts drawer fails to open) — backend works; likely a setState/refetch gap in Tenants.jsx.
Replace placeholder YouTube video id 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' in /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx with actual product demo videos.
Persist Tour dismissal in localStorage so the tour does not reappear for admin on every login — currently blocks E2E flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2526 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers: auth, tenants, receipts, calculators, feedback, admin.

POST /api/auth/google/session stores password_hash='' for Google-only users. Ensure login endpoint rejects empty password_hash so an attacker can't login as a google-only user with an empty string password.

Builder plan calculation: opportunity_cost formula is simplified (down_payment * opp * (months/12)) and does not account for CLP slab disbursements. Results are directionally correct but labelling as 'effective_total_cost' may mislead; consider adding a 'model_notes' field explaining simplifications.
RentReceipt PDF: user.get('name') default returns landlord name from login payload but admin user may have empty name — falls back to '—'. Minor UX.
POST /api/admin/feedback/{fid}/status accepts arbitrary dict — add Pydantic model with enum for status values (new|triaged|resolved|wontfix).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — builder plan, feedback widget, landing demo videos all pass; tenants add works but receipts drawer open failed in automation

seed_data_creation: Registered iter7_<rand>@test.com user, created TEST_Iter7_Flat property, TEST_Tenant_Anil tenant + rent receipt, TEST_regression_prop and TEST_cmp_2 properties, and one feedback record 'TEST_Iter7 please add dark mode toggle'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_7 focus features all work at API level (24/24 pytest pass). Google session endpoint correctly returns 422 on empty body and 400/401/502 on invalid session (as expected — real Emergent session cannot be obtained in test env). Tenants CRUD, rent receipt PDF (verifies %PDF magic), Builder plan (CLP/10_90/20_80/subvention 4 plans), Feedback + admin moderation (list/status), and admin extend_trial all pass. Regression: login, properties CRUD, portfolio summary, compare/score all pass. Frontend: the Onboarding Tour modal (data-testid=tour-modal) blocks clicks on primary CTA buttons — tests must call Skip tour first. All 4 Landing demo-video cards currently point to the same placeholder YouTube id (dQw4w9WgXcQ / Rick Roll) — content fix needed before launch. Tenants UI receipts-drawer automation failed to open after tenant create; backend is fine, likely a frontend list refresh issue in Tenants.jsx.
rca_of_issue: No critical bugs. One medium-priority frontend refresh issue on Tenants page (create tenant does not update visible list before receipts drawer click); two content/UX items: placeholder YouTube ids on landing and sticky Tour modal blocking pointer events.
